vibe: Utilitarian, brutally transparent, clean. Inspired by raw data terminals and architectural blueprints. Heavy emphasis on grids, high contrast, and typography.

headings.usage: Use Black/900 for major titles ('berlin.rent'). Use Regular for subheaders. Tight tracking.

body.usage: Use for all data points (Rent, Sqm, Year), labels, buttons, and badges. Creates a receipt-like trust.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Strict architectural grids. Generous internal padding (p-6, p-8) within tight 1px borders.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: MODE B: The Control Room Grid. 1px borders everywhere. border-collapse on listing feeds.
spacing_and_layout.container_styles: Flat backgrounds, 1px subtle border (border-border), NO soft shadows. Sharp corners (rounded-none).

surface_strategies.cards: Grid Borders (Technical Look). Expose the skeleton. border-b border-border on list items. Flat white surface, black 1px stroke. No radius.
surface_strategies.header: Solid White Background with a hard 1px bottom border. No glassmorphism. It should feel like a sticky tool bar.
surface_strategies.inputs: Sharp 1px borders, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#FF3800] focus:outline-none. Background white. Text mono.
surface_strategies.map: Must use a greyscale or muted monochrome base style (e.g., Carto Positron or Mapbox Light). Map UI controls (zoom, etc.) must be square.
surface_strategies.map_pins: Solid #FF3800 sharp circles or squares. High contrast against the greyscale map.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Cards slightly lift (-translate-y-1) with a sharp, harsh shadow (shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#0A0A0A]). Borders darken.
motion_and_interactions.map_interactions: Hovering on a listing card highlights the corresponding map pin (e.g., scales it up and adds a black ring).

components.buttons: Sharp rectangles (rounded-none). Primary: bg-[#FF3800] text-white hover:bg-[#E63200] font-mono uppercase text-sm. Secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#0A0A0A] text-[#0A0A0A] hover:bg-[#0A0A0A] hover:text-white.
components.badges: Square edges, monospaced text. e.g. 'WARMMIETE' badge: bg-[#F4F4F5] text-[#0A0A0A] border border-[#E4E4E7] text-xs px-2 py-1.
components.toggle_switch: Do not use standard pill toggles. Use blocky, segmented controls (side-by-side rectangular buttons where the active one has bg-[#0A0A0A] text-white).
components.forms: Use Shadcn components but force `rounded-none` and monospace fonts for input fields. Labels must be uppercase monospace tracking-[0.2em].
components.data_visualizations: Heatmap overlays should use D3 or Leaflet hexbins with an opacity of 0.6, ranging from Blue (Low) to Red (High).

images.description: Minimalist Berlin architecture curtain glass, to be used faintly or as an abstract empty state background.
Clean white apartment interior, useful for 'no images' fallback on property cards.

assets.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) with 'regular' or 'bold' weight. Avoid rounded/soft icon sets.

instructions_to_main_agent: LAYOUT: Implement a split-screen desktop layout (Map on left 50-60%, Listings grid on right). On mobile, Map is the main view with a draggable bottom sheet or toggle for listings.
SHADCN MODIFICATIONS: Strip all Shadcn components of their default rounded corners (`rounded-md` -> `rounded-none`). Ensure all shadows are flat/harsh (e.g., `4px 4px 0px #000`) instead of blurred.
MAP IMPLEMENTATION: Use react-leaflet with a minimal greyscale tile layer (e.g., CartoDB Positron). The map is the hero; do not hide it.
DATA ENTRY FORM: Create a distinct, slide-out or modal intake form that feels like a 'tax document' - strictly aligned, monospace inputs, no visual fluff.

ANALYTICS: Implement the 'Am I overpaying' feature using a simple color-coded progress bar or a distinct badge (Green = Below Average, Red = Above Average). Calculate dynamically based on the current viewport's data.
HEATMAP (BONUS): Integrate a heat layer for price/sqm. High density/expensive = #FF3800, Low = #3B82F6.
TESTING (CRITICAL): ALL interactive elements (filters, map pins, form inputs, buttons, toggles) MUST have descriptive `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid='filter-kaltmiete'`).

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure pure black text against #FAFAFA background for maximum readability of rent data.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: Enforce `data-testid` across all interactive elements for robust automated testing.
